status: Base design draft awaiting user visual review before animations/icon. Existing playable artwork is unchanged.
prompt: Create a completely fresh full-body pixel-art design of NIGHTSHADE, the garden's charming adult star thief and trickster, using the labelled old Andy drawing only for identity cues, NOT by tracing or shrinking the old drawing. Key identity: spiky blond hair, dark sunglasses, a confident cheeky grin, a short charcoal leather jacket, dark practical trousers and boots, and a small curved hook on a short loose chain held naturally in one hand. Slim adult cartoon proportions, about four head-heights tall, long readable limbs, neither baby/chibi nor realistically muscular. A relaxed confident asymmetric standing pose suitable as the start of idle/victory/casting animations, facing slightly toward the left/front. Draw him in the EXACT CLEAN ART LANGUAGE of the approved Sir Champignon reference and the finished mole/rabbit/star/garden-board plate: bold continuous 3-4px dark outer contours at this 192px canvas, broad clean color clusters, flat cel shading with only 2-3 shades per material and a small coherent earthy palette. Keep a distinct warm skin/blond hair/charcoal jacket identity; do not copy the knight's armor, helmet, cyan eyes, red plume, broom or mushroom shield. The hook and short chain should be simple chunky readable shapes, not a noisy mass of tiny links. Single full-body character roughly 145-160 pixels tall, every hair spike, boot and hook fully inside the transparent 192x192 frame with at least 12px side/top margins and animation room. Calm neutral base stance, no magic effect yet. No miniature engraving, scratchy lines, dithering, grain, scattered noise pixels, gradients, airbrushing, scenery, floor, text, frame, second character, rabbit/mole/star props or magenta background. Preserve the mischievous garden-fairytale mood of Moonlit Hideout.

referenceImages.usage: IDENTITY CONCEPT ONLY: spiky blond hair, sunglasses, leather jacket, chain and hook. Reinterpret as a fresh clean adult garden trickster. Do not trace its rendering, proportions or pose; ignore the magenta background.
APPROVED ROSTER STYLE: clean bold dark outlines, flat shading, adult cartoon proportions, coherent detail level and sprite scale. Do not copy the knight's identity, outfit or equipment.
FINAL GAME STYLE: mole, rabbit, golden star and garden board. Match their bold outlines, simple readable shapes and clean shaded color clusters; draw only Nightshade.

futureAnimations.idle: Subtle breathing and small secondary motion.
futureAnimations.victory: Expressive full-body celebration with distinct key poses.
futureAnimations.casting: One shared expressive casting animation with thematic magic effects; preserve 1.5-second freeze and stars-spent overlay.
